items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Whereas Cozy was out there playing drum solos with Stuff Smith...

ctx.x: Whereas Cozy was out there playing drum solos with Stuff Smith and with Blanche Calloway and all these bands -- he was a great soloist -- so Cab, to keep up with the times of what Benny was doing, he got Cozy to come in the band because Cozy was a great soloist. That's why. We have explained that.
Now, I want you to go ahead on with your story.
